answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, burned when the recruit misbehaves. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the ivory of a task receipt, and the grove is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
